messages.subject: Caspian - Kestrel completion accounts
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Unrelated to what you're on - Caspian's CFO has queried the completion-accounts adjustment on the Kestrel financing. Can you ask Elena to pull the final funds-flow from the Project Kestrel file and check the working-capital true-up figure? Ravensworth's lawyers want it reconciled by Friday.

Sarah
